question.prompt: Consider the following 6 mathematical statements or expressions: ① \(2a+1\)　② \(x=3\)　③ \(5\)　④ \(a-b>0\)　⑤ \(m/n\)　⑥ \(\pi\). How many are algebraic expressions?

solutions.explanation: A single number or letter is also an algebraic expression. ①③⑤⑥ are algebraic expressions; ② contains an equality sign and ④ contains an inequality sign, so they are not algebraic expressions. There are 4 in total.
solutions.title: Classify all six entries
